# __clinic_info.site.name__

> __clinic_info.site.name__ is the neuropsychology and general health psychology practice of __specialist.name__ (__clinic_info.schema.job_title__; __specialist.license__). It works with children, teenagers and adults at the clinic in __clinic_info.site.locality__ (southern __clinic_info.site.region__), by video call (online therapy) and at home. __hero.promo__.

Key facts:

- Professional: __specialist.name__, __clinic_info.schema.job_title__. __specialist.license__.
- Clinic address: __common.contact.address_lines__.
- In-person service area (municipalities in southern __clinic_info.site.region__): __clinic_info.area_served__.
- Online therapy: by video call, available anywhere in __clinic_info.online_area__.
- Phone and WhatsApp: __common.contact.phone__
- Email: __common.contact.mail__
- Web: __clinic_info.site.url__
- Instagram: __contact.instagram.url__
- Language of attention: __clinic_info.site.language_name__.
- First consultation: informative and free.
- Usual session length: __clinic_info.llms.session_length__.

What is covered: __clinic_info.schema.knows_about__.
